base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: a gleaming high-tech garage bay at the base of the lighthouse, tool walls, hoses, polishing cloths, a circular launch hatch in the floor. Lighting: cool workshop spotlights with copper reflections.
In the shot: Tomkin, an anthropomorphic tabby cat who walks upright, slim and wiry, with burnt-orange "artisanal copper" fur and darker copper tiger stripes, bright emerald-green eyes, long expressive whiskers, a smug confident half-smile, brass welding goggles pushed up on his forehead, and a leather tool belt full of tiny gadgets; Ben Elf, a tiny elf about the height of a teacup, neat and bright-eyed, wearing a pointed green hat, a green jacket with eleven unnecessary pockets, and a belt hung with a small brass horn, a spare horn, a scroll, a magnifying glass, a bag of mixed nuts and a laminated official ID card; Princess Holly, a tiny fairy princess about the height of a teacup, with a shimmering fairy-pink dress, iridescent wings like soap bubbles that catch the light, a little silver tiara, rosy cheeks, and a slender wand that fizzes with small irregular pink sparks; Marvel, an ancient, kindly, slightly stooped wizard with a huge floor-length grey beard tinged with patches of green moss, bushy eyebrows, twinkling eyes, patchwork robes stitched from three different historical eras (medieval velvet, Victorian brocade, 1970s paisley), an absurdly tall pointed wizard hat that nearly scrapes the ceiling, and a gnarled wooden staff; the Tomkin-Mobile, a sleek, aggressive, low-slung racing car with the armoured bulk of a naval battleship, mirror-polished chrome and copper panels, retractable feathered metal wings that fold like a barn owl's, a tailpipe that puffs lavender-coloured bubbles, and a roof rack on top.
Camera: Wide shot of the team in front of the Tomkin-Mobile.
Action: Tomkin slaps the bonnet of the Tomkin-Mobile. Tiny Ben's hand instantly shoots up in the air.
Dialogue: Tomkin (crisp, rapid-fire, precise male tenor with a clipped British accent; superior, exasperated, always certain he is the only rational being in the room, heroic) says: "We are getting them back. In the Tomkin-Mobile. Any questions?"
Sound effects: metallic slap on bonnet, ambience of echoing garage, the hum of machinery.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
